--- title: The Effects of Fixture Congestion on Injury in Professional Male Soccer: A Systematic Review author: Corresponding author date: 2022-08-17 --- Abstract Background Professional soccer teams are often required to compete with ≤ 4 days recovery between matches. Since congested schedules reduce recovery time between matches, players are possibly at an increased injury risk.
